base_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE premium high-fidelity Chinese desktop WEB product screenshot, 16:10 landscape around1600x1000, full bleed, no browser chrome, no device frame, no collage. Product: 知练同行 intelligent fitness coaching. No reference image attached. Preserve established warm ivory #FFF9F1 page, cream #FFFCF8 surfaces, dark brown #402517 ink, muted warm brown #78675B secondary, burnt orange #B9431C primary controls and pale apricot #FFF0DF highlights. Elegant professional warm fitness product, crisp readable Chinese system sans, generous functional whitespace, subtle16px rounded surfaces, delicate warm borders, almost no shadow. No gradients, no giant hero illustration, no equal-card wall or card nesting. Header with the established orange running-person symbol and 知练同行 at left. EXACT global navigation labels in this exact order: 首页 / 实时分析 / 视频分析 / 我的训练 / 健身指南. FIVE text links. Training plans and training records are inside 我的训练. Exercise knowledge and nutrition advice are inside 健身指南. Retain 首页 and keep 实时分析 and 视频分析 as distinct primary links. No 动作分析 primary grouping, no separate knowledge or nutrition primary tabs. Right small anonymous avatar. Main content around1280px wide, one dominant task region, restrained supporting lists. AI consultation is an in-context button 问AI教练, never a global navigation destination. Body16px, labels14px, page title30px. Small legible label UI方案 · 示例数据 at top right. All data is fictional design examples. No health score, total posture score, fake achievements, calories burned, payment, notifications, medical claims, implementation jargon, RAG/API labels or hidden reasoning. Prioritize consistent header, clear typography and user tasks.  Keep the exact approved training-plan page design language. Do not add unimplemented actions, social feeds, rewards, payment, fabricated accuracy, overall posture scores or calories burned. All data fictional UI examples. For page-level forms choose one clear primary commit. Header brand is the existing orange running-person mark, NOT a new dumbbell logo. For training pages global 我的训练 active; knowledge/nutrition global 健身指南 active. Admin/account/settings no unrelated global selected. Modal and state-board designs retain original scope.
